reconcile.note: Adam Clarke identifies the sodomites Asa expelled as the qedeshim, consecrated cult prostitutes, a different offense than the capital act condemned in Leviticus 20:13.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible treats the penalties as flatly incompatible, noting Leviticus demands death for the act while righteous Asa merely exiled the offenders.

sides.snippet: they shall surely be put to death
sides.verseText: If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

sides.snippet: He put away the sodomites out of the land
sides.verseText: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
